facts.fact: Agence Ecofin (17 Aug 2026) says landlocked Burkina Faso relies on coastal neighbours Cote d'Ivoire, Ghana and Togo for submarine-cable capacity, described as three existing transit corridors; the ministry wants Nigeria added.
facts.system: Terrestrial corridors via Cote d'Ivoire, Ghana and Togo

systems.system: Nigeria connectivity link via Niger and Benin
systems.platform: planned terrestrial interconnection, not in service
